This is second application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the applicant/accused, relating to FIR/Crime No.194/2023 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station - Karahi, District Khargone (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 450,
506, 354(C), 376 and 376(2)(n) of IPC alongwith 3/4, 5(l)/6 and 7/8 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

sentences.text:
His first bail application was dismissed on merit vide order dated 26.12.2023 passed by this Court in MCRC No.47807/2023.
3.

Prosecution story, in brief is that the prosecutrix filed a written complaint on 16.08.2023 at police station Karahi, District Khargone, stating that the present applicant is resident of same village as of prosecutrix and in the year 2021, when the prosecutrix was below 18 years, the applicant, despite being married, used to stalk her when she used to go to her school.
Ten months before filing of written complaint, the applicant had entered into her house at around 12:00 PM, when she was alone, had clicked her pictures by his mobile phone and had raped her.
The applicant had threatened to kill her and her family members if she tells about the incident to anyone.

Being scared,
the prosecutrix did not disclose about the incident to her family members.
The aforementioned act was repeated by the applicant on several occasions.

On 29.06.2023, when the prosecutrix was engaged to a person, then the applicant had gone to that person's house and had shown him the pictures of prosecutrix clicked by him, because of which marriage of the prosecutrix was cancelled.
When the parents of the prosecutrix came to know about the pictures of the prosecutrix, then the prosecutrix on being asked by her parents, told about the incident to them.

Thereafter, father of the prosecutrix had exhorted the applicant but he did not stop the same and on 15.08.2023, he went to the house of prosecutrix and had threatened her that he wont let her to get married.
On the basis of written complaint, on the same day, an FIR was lodged against the applicant.
4 . Learned counsel for the applicant/accused submits that the applicant has not committed the offence and he has falsely been implicated in the case.

After dismissal of his first bail application,
prosecutrix (PW-1) has been examined before the Trial Court.

Though she has supported the case of prosecution in her examination-in-chief but in cross-examination, she has admitted that there was conversation between the applicant and prosecutrix through several social media platforms like whatsapp, instagram etc.
therefore, it is clear that prosecutrix was a consenting party for sexual intercourse.
The FIR was lodged belatedly by around 10 months without any plausible explanation.
In paragraph-19 of cross-examination, she also admitted that on the day of lodging of FIR, she was aged around 18 years 04 months.
Applicant is in custody since 16.08.2023.
Trial will take considerable long time for its disposal, therefore, in the changed circumstances, it is prayed that the applicant be released on bail.
5 . On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State has opposed the prayer and prayed for rejection of the application.

6. Having considered the rival submissions and after perusal of the case diary so also considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting on the merits of the case, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail hence, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant - Santosh shall be released on bail upon his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Trial Court during pendency of the trial.

It is further directed that applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Criminal Santosh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187982936/
2 Procedure Code, 1973.
8.
